blocks.html: The data to remove a user account.

types.name: userId
types.description: The ID of the user to remove.

types.name: granting_actor_id
types.description:
The ID of the actor removing the user. When provided, the actor must be
able to grant the roles assigned to the user, since removing the user
removes those assignments.

types.name: granting_scope
types.description: The scope the actor is acting within.
